# Biord | Traceable used cooking oil from Brazil

Biord is a Brazilian digital infrastructure for traceability and marketplace access in the used cooking oil (UCO) chain. It connects generators, collectors, processors and buyers.

- Evidence: generator records, collection events, photos, timestamps, geolocation and custody documentation.
- Mass balance: physical inputs, outputs and inventory records designed with reference to ISCC principles. No current certification is claimed.
- EU UDB: designed to support future interoperability; active connectivity is not claimed.
- Generators: responsible disposal, digital records, commercial opportunities, points, vouchers and partner benefits.
- Industry: waste-based feedstocks for biodiesel, HVO and SAF; renewable energy and energy transition, subject to applicable sustainability verification.
- Institutional history: UN-related sustainability initiatives, Green Sampa and InovAtiva.

## Languages
- https://biord.com.br/pt/
- https://biord.com.br/en/
- https://biord.com.br/es/

Contact: contato@biord.com.br

## Technical interpretation
The traceability platform supports evidence and mass-balance documentation but does not replace third-party auditing, sustainability certification or emissions lifecycle assessments.
